text:
SEO works like the gym. Results come from turning up every week.

Google's page on core updates says it could take several months for Google to notice your site has improved.

So do the boring work weekly. New photos on your Google profile. A reply to every review. Then again next week.

A physio clinic owner in Joondalup tells me: "We get plenty of Facebook leads. They never pick up the phone."

Her receptionist calls them the next morning. By then they've forgotten the form.

Call every new lead within the hour, while they still remember filling it in.

Every time Google runs a core update, the advice online is the same. Rewrite your homepage. Change everything. Tonight.

The majority is ALWAYS wrong.

Google's own page on core updates tells site owners to avoid quick fixes.

Keep doing the same steady work you did last week.
